newsitem.title: USA: Sanderson Farms still assessing fire damage.
newsitem.headline: Sanderson Farms still assessing fire damage.

text.p: Sanderson Farms Inc said it continues to assess the damage caused by a fire that broke out Tuesday at its processing plant in McComb, Miss.

The company said the fire was confined to an area of the plant housing packaging materials and supplies. That area of the plant -- about 40,000 square feet -- was destroyed, the company said, adding that property insurance will cover any repairs and losses due to down time.
The company also said it will resume partial operations at the plant early next week, and full operations within the next four to six weeks.
The cause of the fire -- in which no one was injured -- is still unknown, the company said.
